comparison_token_definition: Raw output prefix through the first EOS/eot inclusive, then capped at max_new_tokens; the logger supplies this prefix and metrics validates prefix consistency.
cross_node_timing_qualifications: Each method retains its own co-located target-only control. Hardware, drivers, allocation priority and preemption histories remain separate per input run.

Raw throughput and cross-method timing rankings across nodes can reflect hardware or system differences. AR-normalized speedups remain within-method comparisons; no same-hardware cross-method ranking is established.

This collection reproduces configured numerical cells and observed T=0 comparisons only. Temperature-one distributional correctness and losslessness remain unestablished; the scientific training gate remains closed.
drafting_cost_definition: drafting_ms and cycle_drafting_ms sum cycle drafting only; drafting_ms_including_unused_final adds separately recorded unused_final_drafting_ms. Measured wall time is not adjusted or reconstructed from components.
equal_turn_tau_definition: Diagnostic mean across questions of the equal-turn mean of per-completion tokens/cycle, averaged across repeats and seeds within each turn; not the canonical reproduction statistic.
pooled_tau_definition: Sum of raw generated tokens / sum of explicit verification cycles
primary_tau_definition: Within each question and repeat, sum raw emitted tokens across all turns and divide by the sum of explicit verification cycles; average repeat ratios within each question, then average questions. Per-turn seed does not split a question-repeat.
qualifications: Primary throughput uses comparison tokens including the terminating token and excludes discarded block overshoot. Raw throughput is diagnostic; no wall-clock metric is derived from tau.
Target-only timing may retain an unused drafter; no autoregressive memory advantage is established.
Matching same-seed outputs or acceptance lengths at T=1 does not establish distributional correctness.

reproduction_gate.qualification: Passing this gate reproduces configured numerical reference cells and finite T=0 checks; it does not prove losslessness or establish T=1 distributional correctness.
reproduction_gate.scope: Published tau reproduction, complete paired coverage, at least five timing repeats, and observed T=0 token comparisons
